title: Portugal Navigates TAP Sale and Housing Crisis · 15 Sep
keywords: Portugal, TAP Air Portugal, privatisation, Air France-KLM, Lufthansa, social housing, European Investment Bank, housing affordability, minority government, Portuguese economy, EIB, Lisbon, housing crisis, airline privatisation, EU financing
notes: Portugal is simultaneously pressing ahead with the partial privatization of national airline TAP and launching a €1.5 billion social housing programme backed by the European Investment Bank. Both initiatives carry high political stakes for the country's fragile minority government, which must demonstrate it can push through market reforms without abandoning its social commitments. The outcome of each will serve as a referendum on Lisbon's capacity to govern decisively at a moment of considerable economic uncertainty.
